name: Resend test-address evaluation
audience_segment: The one backend engineer at a ten-person product team who owns email because nobody else does
request: Write exactly 1 email introducing Resend test addresses to a backend engineer responsible for transactional email. Show a small, useful way to inspect delivered, bounced, and spam-complaint event paths before routing real messages through Resend. Make the first click a documented evaluation step. Keep it professional and concise. Do not assume a current provider, a prior incident, or that a test proves production deliverability.
